Policy:

It is the policy of this hospital to take care of healthcare need of Hospital staff. Hospital heath privileges include all staff members of Hospital. i.e.

  • Permanent
  • Contractual

Health privilege of the hospital includes hospital admission charges only Medicines, implants, Consumable will be at actual & has to bear by employee'

Procedure:

Following procedure & department included in Health Privilege

  • Performance of history and physical exam
  • Performance of local anesthetic techniques
  • Performance of needle biopsies
  • OPD Service without medicines
  • IPD Service – No room & Hospital Charges
